why_exploratory: Developed after the 48-configuration benchmark had been read. The diagnosis it answers (profile fires 40.6% during healthy vs 5.4% during faults) was measured from fault labels, so although the FIX uses no labels - the four components are modelled jointly on healthy data only - the DECISION TO MAKE that fix was informed by outcomes. That is development, not confirmation, and calling it confirmation would be false.
claim_recorded_before_results: Modelling the four components jointly, rather than taking their maximum, will reduce the false-alarm rate at matched detection, because healthy drift has a characteristic joint signature that a max rule cannot represent.
what_would_falsify_it: No reduction in false alarms at matched detection rate on either participant, or a silence gate no better than decoder_guard v1.
confirmatory_test_still_owed: A third participant, or a dataset this project has not touched. T11 and T5 have both been used for development and cannot serve.
clean_out_of_sample_check_available_now: The task-change test (scripts/25) was never used to develop anything, so running v2 through it is genuinely out of sample for that property.
